title: The Ark of the Covenant to Jerusalem
description: David brings the Ark of the Covenant to Jerusalem. On the way, Uzzah dies because he touches the ark, and the ark remains with Obed-Edom for three months. Finally, the ark is brought to the City of David with dancing and rejoicing, but Michal despises David for his dancing.
